discharged: The constructor's engine argument is adopted and its functional reference is released exactly once (EC/DSA/DH/RSA/raw-key).
The legacy verify/encrypt/decrypt arms dispatch to the method the context was built from; a missing method/callback is an explicit -2.
pkey_set_type releases the outgoing engine and pmeth_engine references before storing a new type.
retained: An application-supplied EC_KEY_METHOD/DSA_METHOD/DH_METHOD/EVP_PKEY_METHOD and the ENGINE carrying it must outlive every object built from it (authority contract; standard tables are statics).
The digest-side and cipher-side engine slots remain unimplemented and non-NULL impl is explicitly refused (D01/D02); an engine-backed digest/cipher is not claimed.
The legacy-key ameth family (census L01-L11) is open; a `SAFE_COMPATIBLE` graduation for a consumer using legacy `EVP_PKEY`s must not treat the ENGINE class as complete.
`new_raw_key_int` still reduces the e == NULL ameth lookup (D03); provider-vs-legacy construction order can differ for a type with both.
No Miri/ASan/negative-control evidence was produced in this FAST-only subphase; no mechanism is SAFETY_DISCHARGED.
